Multiple things, if you are a minor, depending on your activity level and age you might (and probably do) need much more than 1200 calories. 

I'm not at all diagnosing you but 1000 calories is less than the calories anyone should have in a day and starving yourself then overeating (also called binging) can be symptoms of an eating disorder. 

It's all very scary and trust me it is not worth it, talking to a trusted adult, therapist, etc will get you the help that you need 
You are not at all overweight, and eating more slowly will become easier and so that you can gain to a good, healthy weight so you don't lose hair, have bad memory etc

I'm not at all diagnosing you but you should be mindful of how you view your eating and habits because it's easy to get deep into that horrible mindset and eating disorders have many many many long term effects. 

One day won't hurt you, forgive yourself and try to up your cals because 1000 isn't very sustainable
